summary: Frontend-only non-regression sweep on web preview (390x844). PASS on ALL 6 review-request items. Boot OK, CGU accepted, login mobiletest123@aqua.com / Test1234! succeeds. All 4 tabs render without crash: Aujourd'hui (drop + Ajout rapide + water-points card), Progrès (chart + Aquanalyse card confirmed), Aquacoach (header 'Aquacoach' + hydration coaching subtitle + chat bubbles), Profil (avatar + goal + language + rappels + Découvrir Premium + Préférences). LABELS: 'Aquacoach' present in translations & rendered UI; 'Aquanalyse' present on Progrès card; ZERO occurrences of 'Coach IA' or 'Analyse IA' anywhere in the rendered HTML across every tab (verified via full page HTML substring search on all 4 tab screens). WATER POINTS: profile-premium-button, link-waterpoints, delete-account-button all present on Profil; tapping link-waterpoints navigates to /water-points and correctly renders wp-locked card + wp-unlock CTA for the free account (Fonctionnalité Premium + 'Passer Premium'). PREMIUM SCREEN: profile-premium-button opens modernized premium screen with the four feature rows (Aquacoach illimité, Statistiques avancées, Tous les badges & défis, Soutenez le projet) and premium-subscribe-button ('Devenir Premium') renders on web (Stripe fallback). AQUACOACH FREE FLOW: coach tab loads chat history without crash and shows the upsell state ('Vous avez utilisé vos messages gratuits' + coach-upgrade-button) because THIS particular account has already consumed its free quota from prior test runs — this is CORRECT behavior (see coach.tsx line 151: limitReached ? coach-upgrade-button : coach-input+coach-send-button). coach-input & coach-send-button are therefore intentionally not rendered for this account state. DELETE ACCOUNT double-confirm modal works: delete-account-button → delete-continue → delete-confirm all visible; cancelled to preserve the shared test account. No red screen, no expo-iap import crash, no runtime error. Only benign warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, expo-notifications push-token listener not supported on web, props.pointerEvents deprecated (all pre-existing web polyfill noise).
action_items: OPTIONAL (context, not a bug): coach-input and coach-send-button testIDs are only rendered while !limitReached. The shared test account mobiletest123@aqua.com has already exhausted its free coach quota, so this iteration only observed the upsell fallback state (coach-upgrade-button). If future iterations need to assert the input+send testIDs, either (a) reset the account's free-message counter server-side, (b) use a fresh account, or (c) mark the user premium via the backend.

OPTIONAL (as flagged in iteration_7): add explicit testID props to the Tabs.Screen entries (tab-today / tab-progress / tab-coach / tab-profile) — current test still uses localized text labels ('Aujourd'hui', 'Progrès', 'Aquacoach', 'Profil') which works but is language-dependent.

OPTIONAL: the applyLocalPremium() → hasActive() StoreKit merge is iOS-native only and cannot be validated on web. Verify on a real iOS build after StoreKit sandbox purchase that (a) auth user.is_premium flips to true via the local merge, (b) Aquacoach unlimited (limitReached stays false), and (c) link-waterpoints shows the permission gate instead of wp-locked. Not testable on web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: src/i18n/translations.ts (FR/EN/ES): all three locales updated to 'Aquacoach' + 'Aquanalyse' — no orphan 'Coach IA' or 'Analyse IA' strings remain. Confirmed via grep across /app/frontend/app + /app/frontend/src.

app/(tabs)/coach.tsx: gate at line 151 correctly hides coach-input/coach-send when limitReached, showing coach-upgrade-button instead. isPremiumEffective is used to hide the messagesLeft counter for premium users. Clean.

app/water-points.tsx (unchanged from iteration_7): wp-locked → wp-unlock → /premium flow for non-premium users is intact and reachable from Profil > link-waterpoints AND from the home-screen 'Points d'eau à proximité' card.
app/premium.tsx (unchanged from iteration_7): IAP_ENABLED=false on web via .web stub, Stripe CTA (premium-subscribe-button) renders, premium-restore conditionally hidden on web — correct.

app/(tabs)/profile.tsx: link-waterpoints, profile-premium-button and delete-account-button all present; small lock icon rendered next to link-waterpoints & link-health for non-premium user (consistent with iteration_7).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 6 review-request assertions (boot+CGU+login, all 4 tabs no-crash, Aquacoach/Aquanalyse labels + zero Coach IA / Analyse IA, link-waterpoints + wp-locked + wp-unlock, profile-premium-button → premium-subscribe-button, delete-account double-confirm)

rca_of_issue: N/A — no regression. The user's original report ('Coach IA still visible, no water points access after purchase') is caused by their installed build being outdated (StoreKit purchase happened on a build that predates the label rename + water-points gate + applyLocalPremium merge). Current source code on drip-track-1.emergent.host web preview shows all 3 fixes applied and rendered: (1) 'Aquacoach' + 'Aquanalyse' labels in FR/EN/ES translations, (2) link-waterpoints row present in Profil > Préférences and reachable, (3) applyLocalPremium() wired in AuthContext + isPremiumEffective in coach.tsx. Recommend user rebuild + reinstall the iOS app (or wait for the next TestFlight/App Store binary) to pick up the new bundle.
